subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Holotype mineral specimens are the original samples used to formally describe and name a newly identified mineral species.
• Geochemist Felix Ricci has identified many new mineral species over the course of his career.
• Alongside colleagues Ousmane Demir and Marta Vogel, he identified the holotype specimen of ricciite on March 14, 2011.
• Alongside colleagues Ousmane Demir, Marta Vogel, and Henrik Laursen, he identified the holotype specimen of demirite on August 3, 2014.
prompt: Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize the discovery of ricciite to an audience already familiar with Felix Ricci?

choices.A: First there was the identification of ricciite on March 14, 2011, and then on August 3, 2014, Felix Ricci identified yet another new mineral species with the help of his colleagues Ousmane Demir, Marta Vogel, and Henrik Laursen.
choices.B: Geochemist Felix Ricci helped identify not only the holotype specimen of ricciite on March 14, 2011, but also that of demirite on August 3, 2014.
choices.C: Felix Ricci is a geochemist renowned for his identification of many new mineral species, including ricciite.
choices.D: On March 14, 2011, Felix Ricci and his colleagues Ousmane Demir and Marta Vogel made the exciting identification of the holotype specimen of ricciite.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The sentence effectively emphasizes the discovery of ricciite to an audience already familiar with Felix Ricci, noting the specific date of the identification, naming the collaborators involved, and characterizing it as an 'exciting identification' without providing background information about who Felix Ricci is.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. The sentence mentions the identification of ricciite only briefly before shifting emphasis to the later identification of demirite, describing it as 'yet another new mineral species,' rather than effectively emphasizing the discovery of ricciite.
